```{=html}
<style>
/* --- Wrapper bar --- */
.ticker-wrap { 
  width: 100%; 
  overflow: hidden; 
  background: #111;        
  padding: 8px 0; 
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;       /* allow z-index inside */
  z-index: 1;               /* base level */
}

/* --- Label that stays fixed --- */
.ticker-label {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 0.3rem 1rem;
  margin-right: 0.5rem;
  background: #333;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 1.1em;
  border-radius: 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  position: relative;       /* allow z-index */
  z-index: 10;              /* sit above scrolling ticker */
}

/* --- Scrolling ticker --- */
.ticker { 
  display: flex; 
  flex-wrap: nowrap; 
  flex: 1;                  /* take remaining width */
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 5;               /* below label */
}

.ticker-move { 
  display: flex; 
  flex-shrink: 0; 
  animation: ticker-move 100s linear infinite;
}

/* --- Ticker items --- */
.item { 
  flex: 0 0 auto; 
  margin-right: 2rem; 
  font-family: monospace; 
  font-size: 1.2em; 
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 1;                
  mix-blend-mode: normal;    
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;               /* ensure below label */
}

/* Colors */
.item.pos { color: #4CFF4C; }
.item.neg { color: #fcba03; }
.item.zero { color: #CCCCCC; }

/* --- Animation --- */
@keyframes ticker-move { 
  from { transform: translateX(0); } 
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); } 
}
</style>
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
wes_cols <- scico(200, palette = "lapaz",direction = -1)  # blue to navy, very smooth

get_latest_rds <- function(dir_path, verbose = TRUE, return_name = FALSE) {
  rds_files <- list.files(path = dir_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(rds_files) == 0) return(if (return_name) NA else NULL)
  
  file_dates <- sub(".*?(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{1,2})\\.rds$", "\\1", basename(rds_files))
  file_dates <- as.Date(file_dates, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  
  latest_file <- rds_files[which.max(file_dates)]
  
  if (return_name) {
    return(basename(latest_file))
  } else {
    return(readRDS(latest_file))
  }
}

last_processed<-readLines("dropbox_data/last_processed.txt")

Enrollment_heat <- get_latest_rds("heatmapdata/")
enroll_heat_week <- get_latest_rds("heatmapdataweekly/")
objectlist <- get_latest_rds("reactable_element")
legend_weekly <- get_latest_rds("weekly_legend")


file_heatmap <- get_latest_rds("heatmapdata/", return_name = TRUE)
file_heatmap_week <- get_latest_rds("heatmapdataweekly/", return_name = TRUE)
file_objectlist <- get_latest_rds("reactable_element", return_name = TRUE)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# extract columns for most recent weeks
recent_weeks <- enroll_heat_week[, c(1, ncol(enroll_heat_week)-2, ncol(enroll_heat_week)-1)]

# rename for clarity
names(recent_weeks)[2:3] <- c("last_week", "this_week")

# compute raw + percent diffs
recent_weeks$raw_diff  <- recent_weeks$this_week - recent_weeks$last_week
recent_weeks$perc_diff <- round(100 * recent_weeks$raw_diff / recent_weeks$last_week, 1)

# handle special cases
recent_weeks$perc_diff <- ifelse(recent_weeks$raw_diff == 0, 0, recent_weeks$perc_diff)
recent_weeks$perc_diff <- ifelse(is.infinite(recent_weeks$perc_diff), NA, recent_weeks$perc_diff)

recent_weeks <- data.frame(
  ticker     = recent_weeks$DISTRICT_NAME,
  last_week  = recent_weeks$last_week,
  this_week  = recent_weeks$this_week,
  raw_diff   = recent_weeks$raw_diff,
  perc_diff  = recent_weeks$perc_diff
)

recent_weeks <- recent_weeks |> drop_na(perc_diff)

# add arrows + descriptive phrasing
recent_weeks$change_text <- ifelse(
  recent_weeks$raw_diff > 0,
  paste0("↑ ", recent_weeks$this_week, " enrollments (", recent_weeks$last_week, " last week)"),
  ifelse(
    recent_weeks$raw_diff < 0,
    paste0("↓ ", recent_weeks$this_week, " enrollments (", recent_weeks$last_week, " last week)"),
    paste0("→ ", recent_weeks$this_week, " enrollments (same as last week)")
  )
)

# build ticker items
ticker_items <- paste0(
  "<div class='item ",
  ifelse(recent_weeks$raw_diff > 0, "pos",
         ifelse(recent_weeks$raw_diff < 0, "neg", "zero")),
  "'>",
  recent_weeks$ticker, ": ",
  recent_weeks$change_text,
  "</div>",
  collapse = ""
)


```

## Weekly Enrollment

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE}
dataListFilter <- function(tableId, style = "width: 100%; height: 28px;") {
  function(values, name) {
    dataListId <- sprintf("%s-%s-list", tableId, name)
    tagList(
      tags$input(
        type = "text",
        list = dataListId,
        oninput = sprintf(
          "Reactable.setFilter('%s', '%s', event.target.value || undefined)",
          tableId, name
        ),
        "aria-label" = sprintf("Filter %s", name),
        style = style
      ),
      tags$datalist(
        id = dataListId,
        lapply(unique(values), function(value) tags$option(value = value))
      )
    )
  }
}


options(reactable.theme = reactableTheme(
  color = "#000000",                        # black text
  backgroundColor = "#E0E2E5",              # light slate gray table background
  borderColor = "#B0B3B8",                  # medium gray borders
  stripedColor = "#D6D8DB",                 # subtle striped rows
  highlightColor = "#A9CCE3",               # light blue for hover
  inputStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#F0F2F5",
    color = "#000000"
  ),
  selectStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#F0F2F5",
    color = "#000000"
  ),
  pageButtonHoverStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#D0D4DB"
  ),
  pageButtonActiveStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#B0B3B8"
  )
))


tbl<-reactable(enroll_heat_week,
          defaultSorted = 'total',
          defaultSortOrder = "desc",
          wrap = TRUE,
          defaultPageSize = 100,
          height = "100%",
          bordered = TRUE,
          highlight = TRUE,
          resizable = TRUE,
          sortable = TRUE,
          pagination = FALSE,
          showSortIcon = FALSE,
          elementId = "districts-table",
          
          defaultColDef = colDef(
            minWidth = 40,
            align = 'center',
            cell = tooltip(),
            style = color_scales(
              data = enroll_heat_week,
              span = 2:(ncol(enroll_heat_week)),
              colors = wes_cols,
              bias = 3,
              opacity = 0.8,
              show_text = FALSE
            )
          ),
          
          columnGroups = objectlist,   
          columns = list(
            DISTRICT_NAME = colDef(name = "District",    
                                   sticky = "left",
                                   filterable = T,
                                   minWidth = 100,
                                   filterInput = dataListFilter("districts-table"),
                                   filterMethod = JS("
        function(rows, columnId, filterValue) {
          if (!filterValue) return rows;
          const terms = filterValue.toLowerCase().split(',').map(t => t.trim());
          return rows.filter(row => {
            const cell = row.values[columnId].toLowerCase();
            return terms.some(term => cell.includes(term));
          });
        }
      ")),
            total = colDef(name = "Annual Total",
                           sticky = "right",
                           minWidth = 225,
                           cell = data_bars(number_fmt = scales::comma,
                             data = enroll_heat_week,
                             fill_color = wes_cols,text_color = "black",
                             bias = 1.4,
                             fill_opacity = 0.9,
                             background = 'transparent',
                             bar_height = 40,
                             text_position = 'outside-end'
                           ),
                           style = list(borderLeft = "2px solid #999999")
            )
          )
) |>
  add_legend(
    data = legend_weekly,
    align = 'left',
    title = 'Enrollment #',
    col_name = 'n',
    colors = wes_cols,
    bias = 3,    number_fmt = scales::comma 
  )

# ticker HTML
ticker <- HTML(paste0('
<div class="ticker-wrap">
<div class="ticker-label">Enrollments since last week:</div>
  <div class="ticker">
    <div class="ticker-move">
      ', ticker_items, ' ', ticker_items, '
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
'))

# put them in exact order: subtitle → ticker → table
tagList(
  subtitle,
  ticker,
  tbl
)
```
